subject: Food Science
title: Breakfast Isn't Essential
description: Learn Breakfast Isn't Essential in one minute.

hook.text: 'Breakfast is the most important meal of the day' was a 1944 marketing slogan by Grape-Nuts cereal. It was never science.

buildup.text: Studies linked breakfast eating to lower weight. But correlation isn't causation—breakfast eaters have healthier habits overall.

discovery.text: Randomized trials: skipping breakfast doesn't cause weight gain, metabolic slowdown, or reduced cognitive performance in adults.

twist.text: Forcing breakfast on people who aren't hungry adds calories without benefit. Some people simply aren't hungry in the morning.

climax.text: For children, evidence is stronger—school breakfast programs improve focus and test scores. Kids and adults differ metabolically.

punchline.text: Eat breakfast if you're hungry. Skip it if you're not. There's no universal rule.

quiz.question: Where did the phrase 'breakfast is the most important meal of the day' originate?
options: A 1944 cereal marketing campaign by Grape-Nuts
